decisions.reason: Demand for height-adjustable desks rose with the post-pandemic shift to flexible workplaces, so this line stays central to the office strategy.
A chair family close to the core offer serves both residential and contract customers, and premium chairs typically sell for many years.
The floor cushions are a cheap niche accessory that uses rug material, so they are kept, though they remain a candidate for pruning.
The sofa fits the core upholstery business but has received little emphasis since launch, which puts it at higher risk of being replaced by newer models.
The rug collection is a flagship of the firm's direction toward complete interiors, so management keeps it despite its distance from core furniture making.
